verification.current_official_referral_reward: free Lifts / product credits for qualifying referrals
notes: LiftmyCV's current official product guide documents an Invite & Earn / Referral Program whose reward is free Lifts (product credits), not cash affiliate commission.
Targeted searches of the current official LiftmyCV domain did not surface a public cash affiliate/partner commission page or application path.
For COSHUMA's revenue-producing affiliate audit, this is therefore classified as no current cash affiliate program found rather than treating the non-cash referral credits as monetization.
If LiftmyCV publishes a cash partner program later, this classification should be re-opened.
